classifier.note: Robinhood tokenized-stock beacon proxy: same bytecode and beacon as NVDA; emits the stock transfer event

registry.method: Robinhood's stock factory announces every listing (name, symbol); names containing 'Dollar' are dropped and the rest classed treasury/commodity/etf/stock by name, as LONG's Dune queries do. Prices are every Chainlink aggregator on the chain, found by its update event and identified by its own description(), folded to the last answer of each UTC hour and forward-filled.
